ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows an organophosphorus-related transition-state structure. On the left there is a phenyl group labeled Ph connected to a carbon chain; in the carbon chain there are adjacent stereocenters, one of which is connected to a negatively charged O, and the other is connected to a P atom and a CO2CH3 ester group. The phosphorus atom at the upper right is connected to one P=O and two OCH2CF3 substituents. The figure also has curved arrows, but the problem requires ignoring the arrows; all hydrogen-containing bonds such as C-H, C-H in CH2, and C-H in CH3 are not counted. Reasoning count: Count by connection pairs between non-hydrogen atoms, with each single bond or double bond counted once as one bond connection. The phenyl part is expanded as a benzene ring; inside the benzene ring there are 6 non-hydrogen bonds, plus 1 external bond from phenyl to the side chain, for a total of 7. The remaining carbon-chain/transition-state skeleton includes: benzylic carbon to adjacent stereocenter 1, stereocenter to O− 1, between the two stereocenters 1, stereocenter to P 1, stereocenter to carbonyl carbon 1, for a total of 5. In the CO2CH3 ester group, excluding the already-counted stereocenter-to-carbonyl-carbon bond, there are C=O 1, carbonyl C-O 1, and O-CH3 1, for a total of 3. In the phosphonate ester part, excluding the already-counted P-skeleton bond, there are P=O 1, two P-O bonds 2, two O-CH2 bonds 2, two CH2-CF3 bonds 2, and the six C-F bonds in the two CF3 groups 6, for a total of 13. The total is 7 + 5 + 3 + 13 = 28.

method.method_draft: First describe the image structure, then partition it into fragments. Count non-H bonds once per connected atom pair: phenyl ring plus its exocyclic bond to the side chain gives 6 + 1 = 7; the remaining carbon-chain/transition-state skeleton gives benzylic C–stereocenter, stereocenter–O−, stereocenter–stereocenter, stereocenter–P, and stereocenter–carbonyl C = 5; the CO2CH3 ester contributes C=O, C–O, and O–CH3 = 3; the phosphonate portion excluding the already-counted P–backbone bond contributes P=O, two P–O bonds, two O–CH2 bonds, two CH2–CF3 bonds, and six C–F bonds = 13. Sum 7 + 5 + 3 + 13 to obtain 28.
